  "verdict": "PASS",
  "legacy_design": false,
  "feature_type": "developer-tooling / cloud orchestration",
  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "ARCH-COVERAGE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "design.md Architecture and Components define bootstrap routing, provider adapters, shared validation, protected CI and verification interactions. Technology choices include Python stdlib, provider CLIs, GitHub Actions and provider-owned state; Layer Specifications explicitly excludes a graphical frontend."
    },
    {
      "id": "NO-CIRCULAR-DEPS",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Architecture's directed flow proceeds from bootstrap through routing, provider skills, validation, prepare, approval, apply, collectors and verification. No component dependency cycle is declared; Cross-Layer Dependencies describes document relationships rather than runtime dependencies."
    },
    {
      "id": "DATA-COVERAGE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "design.md Data Plan supplies Data Entities, Existing Data Affected and Migration Strategy. It defines versioned cloud artifacts, unchanged legacy dispatch, contained no-overwrite storage, secret exclusion and retention prerequisites."
    },
    {
      "id": "API-COVERAGE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "API / Contract Plan defines versioned request, lock, preview, authorization, observation and verification artifacts. Public Invocation Contract specifies skill names, script command, operations, request/output paths, result and input-error envelopes, exit codes and additive compatibility. External Integration Inventory names supported provider API contracts."
    },
    {
      "id": "SECURITY-COVERAGE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "design.md Security Boundaries identifies local-to-CI, CI-to-provider and provider-to-evidence boundaries with authorization, classification and OWASP concerns. security-spec.md refines these with protected environments, scoped OIDC, fixed argument arrays, trusted provenance, redaction and adversarial tests."
    },
    {
      "id": "FRONTEND-BACKEND-CONSISTENCY",
      "result": "SKIP",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "SKIP: Feature Type is developer-tooling / cloud orchestration, explicitly a CLI/skill surface rather than fullstack. frontend-spec.md confirms no browser frontend, routes, client state or API client."
    },
    {
      "id": "TEST-STRATEGY-COVERAGE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Test Strategy and Unit and Integration Boundaries define unit subjects and doubles, subprocess/CI/provider integration boundaries, real compile/synthesis checks, isolated host verification and separately authorized live trials. Four named tests/cloud-orchestration-*.tests.py entry points and task-specific verification addenda provide planned evidence; Documentation and Release Delivery covers TEST-013/014."
    },
    {
      "id": "NO-UNDEFINED-COMPONENT",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "Components defines bootstrap routing, both provider skills, shared validation, cloud profiles, governed CI templates and audit inventory. Named detailed-design subsections define routing, execution, collectors and verification; investigation.md establishes the existing evaluator, registry and bootstrap context."
    },
    {
      "id": "ADR-PRESENT",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "design.md ADR Change Log declares docs/adr/0036-thin-cloud-orchestration.md. The exact precheck-admitted document was read and covers thin adapters, protected CI authorization, separate operation lifecycle and provider-specific execution."
    },
    {
      "id": "DESIGN-SYSTEM-CONFORMANCE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Applicability skipped: design.md Design System Compliance records exactly 'N/A — ds_profile: none'; frontend-spec.md and ux-spec.md confirm no graphical component or token dependency."
    },
    {
      "id": "DOMAIN-CONFORMANCE",
      "result": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Applicability skipped: the host states no domain/ directory exists, consistent with investigation.md's domain-sync statement."
    }
  ]
